baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَنْ binds شَاءَ to the coordinated reflexive verbs يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Willing selects between a beforeward advance and self-delay; the paired t-forms cast direction as something the person adopts, not merely a location assigned from outside.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing supplies the choosing force that governs both alternatives.
Beforeward advance and precedence give يتقدم its forward-directed pole.
Deferral to a later time gives يتأخر a temporal as well as directional counter-pole.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that someone may move forward or backward.
changed_reading.after: An addressed person wills a direction for the self: taking precedence or consigning response to later.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposition joins يتقدم from ق د م to يتأخر from ء خ ر around أَوْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The foot/forepart inventory of ق د م and the rear inventory of ء خ ر turn an abstract contrast into bodily orientation: presenting the front and stepping versus occupying or exposing the rear.

activation_trace.role: The foot used for stepping supplies an embodied vehicle for advance.
The forepart or leading edge makes advance a presentation of one's front.
The rear or posterior part supplies the opposed bodily orientation.

changed_reading.before: Forward and backward are abstract positions on a scale.
changed_reading.after: The choice can be pictured as self-positioning: step and face forward, or turn the rear toward what addresses you.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يتقدم and يتأخر pair roots whose inventories include prior standing and postponement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Advancing can establish a deed, merit, or standing that has gone ahead, while delaying leaves the response deferred; the axis therefore combines sequence with consequence-bearing rank.

activation_trace.role: Precedent merit and prior standing let advance denote what one establishes ahead of oneself.
Postponement supplies the contrasting failure to place the response ahead.
Willing makes precedence or deferral an adopted relation rather than bare chronology.

changed_reading.before: The verbs contrast sooner and later movement.
changed_reading.after: The verbs also contrast establishing something ahead with withholding it into lateness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening imperatives decompose advance into resolved rising, separation from an attachment, and restraint of the self. Forwardness is disciplined reorientation, not mere velocity, and restraint need not equal retreat.

activation_trace.role: Forward advance is the focus motion whose internal structure the imperatives revise.
Delay remains the opposed focus possibility but is distinguished from purposeful restraint.
Rising with resolve toward a matter supplies initiation rather than simple locomotion.
Cutting off and separating supplies the detachment that makes a changed direction possible.
Holding the self from panic makes advance sustained and controlled rather than impulsive.

structural_cues: 74:2-7 presents a compact imperative series whose actions include rising, separating, and holding fast before the focus choice appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the opening supplies resolved rising, separation, and self-restraint. Inference: these are functional stages of يتقدم and distinguish restraint from يتأخر. Live alternative: the commands may characterize only the initial addressee without defining the later human choice.

changed_reading.before: Advance means simply moving sooner or farther forward.
changed_reading.after: Advance is a disciplined sequence of rising, detaching, and holding course; not every pause or restraint is retreat.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hard ascent and a later turn of the back polarize the focus verbs: advancement can be costly upward effort, whereas self-delay can become an active reversal coupled with self-magnification.

activation_trace.role: Bold forward undertaking allows advance to carry cost and courage.
The rear image anchors retreat as bodily reversal rather than neutral lateness.
A hard, arduous ascent makes forward movement costly rather than automatically favorable or easy.
Turning the back and turning away supplies an enacted image of the rearward pole.
Self-greatness supplies the affective force that can drive the turn away.

structural_cues: The sequence 74:18-23 moves through calculation, looking, facial contraction, turning the back, and self-magnification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one context image is arduous ascent, while another sequence culminates in turning the back and self-greatness. Inference: they furnish opposed trajectories for the focus pair. Live alternative: صعودا may name imposed hardship rather than the positive path of يتقدم.

changed_reading.before: Advance and delay differ chiefly by position or timing.
changed_reading.after: Advance may require costly undertaking, while delay may be the culmination of a deliberate, pride-driven turn of the back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same stated datum in 74:31 operates as a test but produces growth and settled knowledge in some, turbulent doubt in others, and opposed path outcomes. The focus pair therefore marks divergent responses to one disclosure, not unequal access to two different disclosures.

activation_trace.role: Advance supplies the positive directional result of responding to the shared disclosure.
Delay supplies the counter-result of deferring or failing to settle into response.
Increase and growth make one response cumulative rather than merely binary.
Testing metal or a person supplies the separating mechanism by which one datum reveals different responses.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies the stabilized advancing response.
Turbulent doubt supplies the destabilized counter-response.
Straying from guidance and intended direction makes the negative result explicitly path-like.
Gentle indication toward a path and truth makes the positive result explicitly directional.

structural_cues: Within 74:31, one numerical sign is followed by certainty, increase, absence of doubt, questioning, misdirection, and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a single sign is called a test and is followed by growth/certainty or doubt, then misdirection/guidance. Inference: this response split operationalizes يتقدم أو يتأخر. Live alternative: the focus verbs could summarize conduct more broadly rather than this specifically epistemic bifurcation.

changed_reading.before: People independently choose one of two moral positions.
changed_reading.after: One disclosure assays its hearers: response grows and settles into a path, or destabilizes and falls away from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding night/dawn sequence gives the focus opposition a temporal-cosmic image: one phase recedes to its end while another removes a covering. Advance and retreat become threshold relations to disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Beforeward movement anchors the human side of the changing temporal horizon.
Lateness and deferral anchor the human possibility of remaining with a receding phase.
A thing reaching its latter end and passing supplies the recession side of the transition.
Removing a cover supplies disclosure as what the new phase does.

structural_cues: The oaths by the moon, the night as it recedes, and the dawn as it unveils occur directly before 74:35-37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: night passes at its latter edge and dawn removes covering immediately before the focus. Inference: their turnover images human advance/retreat as relation to disclosure. Live alternative: the cosmic sequence may magnify the warning without mapping separately onto each focus verb.

changed_reading.before: The two verbs place people on a static forward/back scale.
changed_reading.after: People orient within a moving threshold: advance into uncovering or remain attached to what is receding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel converts direction into acquisition and legal holding: whichever course the self takes becomes its own earning, and the self is held as collateral by that acquisition.

activation_trace.role: Willing anchors the chosen course whose consequences are then acquired.
A deed or standing gone ahead anticipates consequence-bearing acquisition.
The very self or thing itself identifies what is exposed to the consequence.
Seeking and obtaining gain supplies acquisition as the link between course and consequence.
A pledge held against a right supplies the legal mechanism by which the self is bound to what it acquired.

structural_cues: 74:38 follows the focus without an intervening scene change and states كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the focus offers willed direction; the next ayah joins self, acquisition, and held pledge. Inference: directional acts become the acquired claim that holds the actor. Live alternative: 74:38 may state a general accountability rule rather than specify the mechanics of each focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Advance or retreat is a momentary choice of position.
changed_reading.after: Direction is acquired into the chooser's account until the self itself stands as collateral for the course taken.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later interrogation turns direction into a route made by repeated omissions and shared immersion: one is inserted into a path, keeps entering a discourse or affair with others, and continues until certainty arrives.

activation_trace.role: Intentional turning toward a matter anchors advance as committed approach.
Deferral anchors the delayed responses that accumulate through the later confession.
Insertion of one thing into another turns outcome into entry along a consequential route.
Entering discourse or an affair supplies repeated social immersion along that route.
Coming or arrival supplies the route's terminal limit when certainty reaches them.

structural_cues: The question in 74:42 is answered by repeated first-person plural clauses in 74:43-46 and terminated by حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا in 74:47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: later speech links insertion, repeated communal entering, several omissions, and eventual arrival. Inference: these clauses unfold يتقدم أو يتأخر as a cumulative route. Live alternative: سلك may describe only the final placement, while the listed acts remain reasons rather than stages of travel.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks for a single decision between two directions.
changed_reading.after: Direction becomes a path assembled through repeated practice, omission, and company until its endpoint arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder scene gives يتأخر a kinetic anatomy: turning the side away becomes recoiling distance and then outright flight. Delay is no longer passive lateness but escalating evasion from an address.

activation_trace.role: The rear image anchors retreat as an embodied orientation.
Willing keeps the depicted recoil connected to the focus ayah's volitional construction.
Turning one's side away supplies the first bodily rotation from the reminder.
Recoiling and creating distance intensify turned orientation into withdrawal.
Flight and escape complete the escalation from delay to active evasion.

structural_cues: 74:49-51 asks why they turn from the reminder, then presents a continuous simile of startled flight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the scene progresses from turning the side, through recoiling distance, to flight. Inference: this sequence concretizes يتأخر as escalating evasion. Live alternative: the simile may characterize a later audience response without exhausting the broader temporal sense of يتأخر.

changed_reading.before: To delay is to remain behind or act later.
changed_reading.after: To delay can be an embodied act of turning, recoiling, and fleeing from the reminder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence places fear/anticipation beside الآخرة and then repeats reminder language. Because الآخرة shares the focus retreat root, delaying acquires an object-horizon: postponement can be refusal to let the later/last become presently recollected.

activation_trace.role: Deferral in the focus verb anchors the temporal act being revised.
Intentional turning toward a matter supplies the opposed present approach.
Anticipatory fear supplies a present affect oriented toward what is expected.
The later or last after the first turns abstract delay into a named temporal horizon.
A reminder supplies the means by which the absent or later horizon is made present to attention.

structural_cues: 74:53 denies fear of الآخرة; 74:54 immediately reasserts that the discourse is a تذكرة.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: afterness, anticipatory fear, and reminder are adjacent, and afterness shares the focus root. Inference: يتأخر can describe keeping the later horizon deferred from present attention. Live alternative: الآخرة may be only the object of fear and not a semantic expansion of يتأخر.

changed_reading.before: Retreat means falling behind on a linear path.
changed_reading.after: Retreat may consist in continually relegating the Later to 'later,' while advance lets reminder make that horizon operative now.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's human willing is echoed by whoever wills to remember, then enclosed by an exception naming divine willing. The choice remains grammatically attributed to the human, but its activation is not represented as self-grounding.

activation_trace.role: Will toward a thing anchors the focus ayah's explicitly human selection.
Advance is one focus outcome governed by the human willing construction.
Deferral is the counter-outcome governed by the same human willing construction.
The paired divine willing occurrences govern opposed directional outcomes of misdirection and guidance.
The repeated whoever-wills formula identifies remembering as a concrete enactment of human response.
The exception naming divine willing places an outer condition around human remembering.

structural_cues: The formula مَن شَاءَ appears in 74:37 and 74:55, while 74:56 follows with إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: human willing governs advance/retreat and later remembering, while divine willing governs guidance/misdirection and conditions remembering. Inference: the human choice is nested rather than erased. Live alternative: the sequence can affirm two levels of willing without specifying their causal relation.

changed_reading.before: The focus presents an autonomous human choice between two courses.
changed_reading.after: The human really wills and responds, yet that willing is textually nested within a wider divine willing rather than portrayed as its own first cause.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads an ethical-temporal contrast through anatomical forepart and rear branches. It remains anchored in both focus roots and the paired reflexive verbs, but those branches do not establish an anatomical lexical sense here; downstream prose should present it only as an embodied spatial image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The coordinated focus verbs derive from roots whose inventories explicitly oppose forepart/leading edge to rear/posterior part.

activation_trace.role: The forepart and leading edge image makes advance a mode of presenting one's front.
The rear and posterior image makes retreat a mode of presenting one's back.

changed_reading.before: The alternatives rank people abstractly as ahead or behind.
changed_reading.after: The alternatives can be imaged as how a person presents the self to the warning: frontward engagement or rearward exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy: a test of metal is carried into human directional response. It remains valid as an activation because 74:31 names the human/metal testing branch and the focus supplies the divergent motions, but the reader supplies the assay-to-direction arrow; render it as a diagnostic image, not a claim that people are literally metal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opposed focus verbs provide the two revealed directions, while شَاءَ keeps each response attached to willing.

activation_trace.role: Will toward a thing anchors the divergent response in the focus construction.
Forward advance supplies one result revealed under testing.
Deferral supplies the counter-result revealed under testing.
Testing metal or a person supplies an assay image in which one stimulus reveals differing composition or response.

changed_reading.before: The warning sorts people after independently formed choices.
changed_reading.after: The warning can be pictured as an assay whose pressure makes latent orientation appear as advance or retreat.

strongest_changes: The shared sign in 74:31 turns advance/retreat into divergent responses under one assay: growth and certainty versus doubt and loss of direction.
The immediate self-acquisition-pledge sequence makes direction consequential: the chooser becomes held by what the course acquires.
The reminder-flight sequence converts delay from passive lateness into active turning, recoil, and escape.
Repeated ش ي ء constructions preserve human willing while nesting it within divine willing.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots support several live coordinate systems at once: volitional, bodily, temporal, rank-bearing, legal, epistemic, and cosmic. Whole-surah repetitions do not collapse these into one verdict; they repeatedly operationalize the same advance/retreat pair through different mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The night/dawn mapping is strongly adjacent and spatially coherent, but it may magnify the warning rather than assign a separate semantic value to each focus verb.
The prior-merit branch of ق د م may be an evocative consequence model rather than a direct nuance of يتقدم in this form.
The repeated human and divine willing constructions establish nesting, but the packet alone does not settle the exact causal relation between the two levels.
